newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt says buys 165,000T HRW wheat.
newsitem.headline: Egypt says buys 165,000T HRW wheat.

text.p: Egypt's Holding Company for Food Industries said on Monday it had bought 165,000 tonnes of hard red winter wheat and/or hard Australian wheat, at seller's option, for July and August shipment.
Muharram Ghanem, head of the company's sales sector, told Reuters the purchases were in the following consigments -
-- Two shipments of 55,000 tonnes +/- 5 percent for July shipment at $168.25 per tonne.
-- One shipment of 55,000 tonnes +/- 5 percent for August shipment at $168.75 per tonne.
